content: {"episode_id":"ep-05145","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the denial of CPT 93247 based on the documented clinical indication, acknowledging that prior authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents a history of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying arrhythmia, with supraventricular tachycardia, unspecified atrial fibrillation, and sick sinus syndrome. Given this complex clinical picture, the note states that prolonged monitoring is required to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances."}
